اقترعتن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَعْتُنَّ (iqtaraʕtunna) /iq.ta.raʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اُقْتُرِعْتُنَّ (uqturiʕtunna) /uq.tu.riʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
